caption: The drawing depicts a carousel horse positioned as if in mid-gallop with its front legs raised off the ground. The horse is painted mostly dark brown, with a lighter-colored mane and tail, both rendered in a grayish hue. The saddle and harness are depicted in muted green, bordered with a reddish hue, while the saddle itself is brown with some visible wood grain texture. The horse's hooves are painted a lighter color, mostly white, with some signs of wear and tear. The horse has a red bridle with a gold-colored ring at its mouth, and its mouth is open, showing its teeth. The body and painted decor show visible signs of age, such as chipped paint and worn areas, particularly on the legs and saddle. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, highlighting the detailed rendering of the carousel horse as the central subject.
title: Carousel Horse
